## JustGo_mobile: minutes where avg view duration exceeded 30 s
Built on the same `makeTimeseries { avg_ms = avg(toDouble(duration)) }, by: { os.name }, interval: 1m` as the JustGo_mobile chart, so the numbers match it. One row for every minute where an OS's average went over **30 s**, newest first. Columns: `Time start` (start of the minute), `avg_ms` (in milliseconds), `OS`. Default timeframe: last 24 hours.

- `duration` is stored in nanoseconds, so the threshold is `30000000000` (30 s) and `avg_ms` is divided by 1,000,000 for display.
- Beyond about 24 hours Dynatrace widens the 1-minute interval (10 min at 7 days), so each row then averages a longer window.

sections.title: JustGo_mobile minutes with avg view duration > 30 s

input.value:
fetch user.events
| filter characteristics.has_view_summary == true
| filter frontend.name == "JustGo_mobile"
| makeTimeseries { avg_ms = avg(toDouble(duration)) }, by: { os.name }, interval: 1m
// one row per OS per minute
| fieldsAdd pts = iCollectArray(record(time_start = timeframe[start] + interval * iIndex(), v = avg_ms[]))
| expand pts
// duration is in nanoseconds: 30 s = 30,000,000,000 ns
| filter pts[v] > 30000000000
| fields `Time start` = pts[time_start], avg_ms = round(pts[v] / 1000000, decimals: 0), OS = os.name
| sort `Time start` desc
